name: FlexGrid
description: A flexbox-based responsive grid layout. A simpler, legacy-friendly alternative to CSS Grid. Uses a 12-column model where FlexGridItem children declare their span.

notes: FlexGrid is a layout utility with no inherent semantics.
Content inside grid items should provide its own accessible roles and labels.

children.description: FlexGridItem children that compose the grid layout.

subcomponents.FlexGridItem: A single cell within the FlexGrid. Uses the span prop (1–12) to control width as a fraction of 12 columns.

do: Use FlexGridItem span values that add up to 12 per row for a full-width layout.
Use FlexGrid for simple column layouts that do not require CSS Grid features.
Wrap items in FlexGridItem to control column sizing.
dont: Do not use FlexGrid for complex two-dimensional layouts — use Grid instead.
Do not use span values greater than 12.
Do not place content directly inside FlexGrid without wrapping in FlexGridItem.
